description: Pay an owned, unpaid invoice. SPENDS MONEY — confirm with the human first. If the prepaid balance covers the whole invoice, it is paid from the balance right away (`paid_from_balance: true`, `status: paid`, new `balance`; ordered servers are then created automatically — poll list_vps). Otherwise nothing is charged and a PayRam crypto `checkout_url` is returned (`paid_from_balance: false`); the invoice settles automatically once the on-chain payment confirms. Balance top-up invoices are always paid by crypto. Safe to retry: an invoice is never charged twice (a repeat returns 409 `Invoice is already paid`). Requires: token. Pass invoice_id exactly as returned (a code like "2RUAWV4"). Pays from the balance if it covers the invoice; otherwise a human pays checkout_url.

invoice_id.description: Optional. Invoice id exactly as returned by order_vps / topup_balance, e.g. "2RUAWV4" (a plain number is also accepted).

name: pay_invoice
title: Pay an invoice
